title: Sell prescribed energy products only if certified and labelled
what: Sell prescribed electrical (and gas) products only if they are certified and labelled as complying with the safety standards.

sources.title: Energy Products (Safety and Efficiency) Act 2000 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A trader must not sell an energy product of a class to which this subsection applies unless it is labelled so as to indicate its compliance with applicable safety and performance standards

sources.title: Energy Products (Safety and Efficiency) Act 2000 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A trader must not sell an energy product of a class to which this subsection applies unless it is labelled under the authority of a certification body or the Technical Regulator so as to indicate its certification by that body or the Technical Regulator

sources.title: Energy Products (Safety and Efficiency) Act 2000 (SA)

sources.quote: Technical Regulator means the person holding or acting in the office of Technical Regulator under the Electricity Act 1996;
